'''Argazdan''' was the native language of the [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] species from [[Argazda/Legends|Argazda]] and the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]].<ref name="ditspol">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref> During the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]], Argazdan was the primary language of the break-away [[Argazdan Redoubt]]. By the Imperial era, a modern form of the language had developed.<ref name="ditspol" />

==Known Vocabulary==
*''[[Habensa]]'' &ndash; literally "one who builds"; considered to be synonymous with [[Architect/Legends|Architect]].
